release_notes:
- Credits Added: "This Month" and "This Year" now use the calendar month and year (from the 1st / from Jan 1) instead of a rolling 30-day / 12-month window, and respect the store's timezone.
- Profit (dashboard + Profit/Loss report): now counts orders by their completion date (when completed/replied), not the order-placed date. Only completed orders are included, so profit falls in the period the order was actually completed.
- The header "Full Screen" action is hidden on small/mobile screens on every page except the dashboard.
- Reverted the enlarged header logo from 1.0.18 back to the standard size.
